title: For an integer multiplicity current on ℝ^P and closed F: spt T ⊆ F iff R.measure(Fᶜ) = 0
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, T ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) and let R be an integer multiplicity representation (IMRep univ n) with R.Represents T. Let F ⊆ ℝ^P be closed. Then spt T ⊆ F if and only if R.measure(ℝ^P ∖ F) = 0, where R.measure = θ·H^n⌞M is the weight measure (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier).withDensity R.mult.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (F : Set (Euclid P)), R.Represents T → IsClosed F → (T.support ⊆ F ↔ R.measure Fᶜ = 0)
